subject: Sprint handoff: launch gaps and remediation plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Bryant <alicia.bryant@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint handoff: launch gaps and remediation plan

Team —

Quick sync to capture the remaining gaps before we freeze the launch checklist for Acme (DEAL-7841). I consolidated blockers from the GTM playbook run and ops dry run; attachment is a short table of gaps and proposed mitigations. High-level asks below: 

1) Enablement: finalize 2 quick-start labs + one-pager for support.
2) Pricing: confirm if we lock the add-on bundle or leave as configurable at GA.
3) Docs: publish the troubleshooting matrix and rollout notes to the staging drive.
4) Support: confirm on-call overlap for the first 48 hours post-GA.

I've tentatively assigned owners in the sheet but want alignment from this group by end-of-day Friday. If we cannot close the two critical items (pricing bundle decision and support overlap), we need to shift the enablement hangout and the customer staging window.

Attachment: launch-ops-gaps-v1.xlsx (summary table)

Proposed next steps:
- Internal working session Thursday 10am PT (30m) — quick remediation plan and owners.
- Final go/no-go check with Laura Friday 2pm PT.

Please reply with any redlines to the mitigation suggestions and note if you cannot make the Thu/Friday windows.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Bryant <alicia.bryant@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint handoff: launch gaps and remediation plan

Karthik — thanks for pulling this together. Read the sheet and here's what enablement can commit to by GA if we get the bundle decision by EOD Thursday: 

- Deliverable A: two 15–20 minute quick-start labs (video + walkthrough) — owner: Marissa (deliver by Tue next week).
- Deliverable B: one-pager cheat sheet for Support with triage steps and escalation matrix — owner: Kim (draft by Fri).
- Training: 45m enablement drop-in for Sales & CS scheduled for Wed after GA (recorded).

Concerns / open items:
- We need the final pricing SKU to populate lab examples. If Pricing doesn't lock, we'll have to ship the labs with placeholders and run a follow-up minor update.
- Docs team needs the troubleshooting matrix in structured markdown; I can pair with Docs on Friday morning.

Attachment: enablement-playbook-draft.pdf (4 pages)

I can make Thu 10am PT. If anyone can't, suggest we record and keep the working doc live.

—Marissa
Senior Manager, Product Enablement
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint handoff: launch gaps and remediation plan

Agree with the ask. Quick pricing note: the add-on bundle we tested in the pilot performed well with the pilot cohort, but legal flagged one clause in the MSA that will need a minor redline if we include the bundled discount as a guaranteed term. If we need a GA decision, I'd propose two options:

A) Lock bundle as "recommended" at GA and finalize contract language in a targeted amendment during onboarding (faster).
B) Delay bundle lock to post-GA (2 weeks) and use configurable SKUs at launch (slower but clean contract).

If leadership prefers option A we should get an exceptions note from Legal and a small approval from Finance.

I'll sync with Legal this afternoon and can escalate to Laura if needed. Also tagging our external contacts: Alicia / Gavin — will either option break your procurement or rollout plan?

Attachment: pricing-bundles-v3.docx (two pages of proposed bundles)

—Ben
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Two priorities from my side before I sign off at Friday's 2pm GA checkpoint: 

1) Pricing approach: I prefer Option A (lock recommended bundle) provided Legal & Finance sign an exceptions memo — Ben, please surface the ask and attach the memo to the Friday readout.
2) Support overlap: we need documented confirmation from Acme that on-call overlap is acceptable and that they'll provide a staging liaison. If Acme requires less overlap we should at least get a 24hr coverage commitment from Support.

If both are green, I will give a conditional go at the Friday review and ask CS to prioritize any outstanding enablement gaps in the first-week backlog.

Note: I will be on a tight schedule Friday but can make the 2pm PT check-in. Expect a brief set of clarifying questions; please keep the readout to 10 minutes.

Laura
Head of GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

Karthik / team —

Thanks for the detailed breakdown and for pulling us into the loop. From Acme's perspective:

- Pricing: Option A works for procurement as long as the contract language includes the conditional clause you mentioned (amendment acceptable). We can sign and proceed with the recommended bundle; procurement will approve the exception memo.
- Support overlap: we can commit to a staging liaison and a 24–48 hour overlap window post-GA. Gavin will be the primary liaison for the staging week.
- Staging schedule: Gavin attached deployment windows and a short checklist; we have a shared drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-launch-staging (access granted to the redwoodinference.com group).

We appreciate the compact timeline. Please send the final support cheat sheet to our liaison and we'll validate during the staging window.

Alicia Bryant
Head of Cloud Integrations
Acme Analytics

Attachment: acme-staging-windows.pdf (deployment windows)
